title: Assemblies & Export
desc: Combine rendered chapters into finished audiobook files.
lede: Assembly is the finish line: turn your rendered chapters into a real audiobook file.
body:
At a glance
  • Assemble a project into one file.
  • Download M4B and manage outputs.
  • Edit descriptions and see stats.

Assemble a project

Combine finished chapters in order into a single audiobook. Chapter order and titles come from your project.

Download & manage outputs

Download the M4B (or MP3) and manage past outputs. M4B is the standard chaptered audiobook container.

Descriptions & stats

Edit the description and review stats like total duration before you publish or share.
